caption: The drawing depicts two stylized birds perched on the leafy branches of a plant that grows out of a geometric planter. The planter is an inverted trapezoid with a red border, gold body, red dots, and gold feet, centered at the bottom of the composition. Thick, dark green leaves extend upwards from the planter. The lower bird, perched about halfway up, has a red head and belly, brown wings, yellow chest, and a black tail, with a yellow beak and legs. Above, a second bird has a light brown head, chest, and legs, a red patch on the face, a black tail, dark brown wings, and a yellow beak. To the right of the birds, a large, stylized flower with red, dark green, black, and gold petals hangs down from a curving green stem. The background is a light beige color. At the bottom, centered text reads, "FROM A BAPTISMAL CERTIFICATE 1841." Additional small type below notes, “FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA PLATE No. 2,” “INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN,” and “PENNA ART PROJECT W P A.”
title: Plate 12: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
